answer.reason: The verses tell two events of the plain: Lot chose it, and the LORD overthrew it with its cities.

clauses.english: was chosen by Lot when he parted from Abram
clauses.quote: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan

clauses.english: was overthrown by the LORD, with its cities and all their inhabitants
clauses.quote: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain

doubts: 2SA 18:23 (Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain) only names a route and may refer to a different plain; left out.
